title: Can Colts strike the win column to avoid 0-3 start?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Can Colts strike the win column to avoid 0-3 start?
sources.description: Only seven NFL teams have recovered from an 0-3 start, although the Texans are the only team to accomplish that feat twice this century and did so in 2025. Now Houston flies in, aiming to avoid another 0-3 start.
